blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary.
  We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking.
  On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark differ in how candidates are produced,
through extra heads on the target, a feature-level autoregressive or diffusion
drafter, and distinct training recipes. They share a decision we do not: they
draft in the target’s own vocabulary. One node of the candidate tree is
therefore one target token, and the only lever left is more nodes, whether by
deeper trees, wider trees, more heads or higher draft accuracy. Each of those
raises the tokens banked per pass, and each runs into the same ceiling, because
the quantity being multiplied is fixed at one target token per draft decision.
That unit is treated as a constant because the tokenizer makes it look like one.

blocks.en:
In Qwen3’s vocabulary “United States of America” is four tokens and for i in range is four tokens, and no adjacent pair of them exists as a
single entry. The pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned,
so no amount of BPE training can produce a multi-word token. This is a property
of the tokenizer rather than of any model, and it is the gap the method
exploits.

blocks.en: SuperBPE [ 1 ] makes the same argument on the tokenizer side:
blocks.zh: SuperBPE [1] 在示意器方面提出同样的论点:

blocks.en:
“Whitespace is not a reliable delimiter of meaning, as evidenced by
multi-word expressions (e.g., by the way), crosslingual variation in the number
of words needed to express a concept (e.g., spacesuit helmet in German is
Raumanzughelm), and languages that do not use whitespace at all (e.g.,
Chinese).”
blocks.zh:
“白空间不是意义的一个可靠划定者,这一点从下列事实中可以证明:
多词表达式(例如,顺便说一句),数字的跨语言变化
表示一个概念所需的词语(例如,德国的航天服头盔是
Roaumanzughelm),以及完全不使用白空间的语言(例如,.
中国). “

blocks.en:
They also give the historical reason the constraint exists, namely that
whitespace pretokenization “made sense in the historical context of
Sennrich et al. (2016), which aimed to improve word-level tokenization by
segmenting words into morphologically meaningful subwords” [ 6 ] .
It is an inherited convention, not a design requirement.

白空间预记化“在历史背景中具有意义。
Sennrich等人(2016年),旨在改进字面符号化
将单词分割成具有形态意义的子词” [6].
这是一项继承的公约,而不是一项设计要求。

target. The multi-word vocabulary lives only in a draft head, and every unit is
expanded back into the target’s own tokens before verification.

blocks.en:
The configuration the results converge on is a 3.434 M head at 0.0854% of the
target, which reaches 2.2–2.3 × \times on maths while keeping 92.3% of the
21.94 M head’s GSM8K tokens per pass (84.9% on MATH-500). It is the first in
this programme small enough to train and run on the device that produces the
text, which makes the natural frame on-device continual learning: a drafter
whose vocabulary adapts to one writer, in the way a mobile keyboard’s suggestion
model does, except that ours suggests to the target model rather than to the
user, with the target’s own forward pass as arbiter. What makes it safe to adapt
is that the verifier decides every token, so an adapting draft vocabulary can
change speed and cannot change output.

blocks.en:
SuperBPE [ 1 ] . Two-stage BPE: stage 1 is ordinary BPE to a
transition point t t , then stage 2 resumes without whitespace pretokenization so
merges can bridge spaces. At 200k vocabulary it encodes text in 33% fewer
tokens. It has no drafting, no speculative decoding, and requires retraining the
model.

标志。 它没有起草,没有投机解码,需要再培训
型号。

AdaptiVocab [ 2 ] swaps 10,000 low-frequency tokens for n n -grams of existing tokens (max n = 3 n=3 , greedy longest-match at inference),
rebuilds their rows from the constituent embeddings, then fine-tunes the
embeddings plus the first and last layer on about 8M domain tokens, for over
25% fewer tokens. The saving is counted in tokens and never in wall clock.

OMP transplantation [ 5 ] is a training-free tokenizer

blocks.en: 2.2 Speculative decoding — leaves the target frozen
blocks.zh: 2.2 分光解码——使目标冻结

blocks.en:
REST [ 7 ] is the nearest prior art on the drafting axis. It
retrieves n n -grams from a datastore in target tokens, so fertility collapses
its matching context: a 16-token retrieval key is about 1.5 Telugu words. The
datastore must be in the target’s tokenisation, and Qwen holds 253 Indic tokens,
so the corpus shatters before it is indexed.
blocks.zh:
REST [7]是起草轴上最接近的前作. 这个
从目标符号中的数据存储器中获取 n - grams, 因此生育率崩溃
它的匹配上下文:一个16个托肯的检索密钥是大约1.5个泰卢固字. 那个
数据存储器必须在目标标记中,而Quen持有253个索引,
故血压在指数化之前就崩溃了。

blocks.en:
EAGLE-3 [ 8 ] is our head-to-head baseline: a 218.2M drafter,
one target token per node, tree-verified. It drafts over a truncated vocabulary
of 32,000 ids out of 151,936 on Qwen3-4B, or 21.06%. A target token outside
that set is undraftable at any tree size or depth, which bounds its tokens per
pass at 1 + ∑ k coverage k 1+\sum_{k}\text{coverage}^{k} .

Both vocabularies are built from the target’s own distilled maths completions,
and both are dominated by formatting rather than English phrases . The
twelve most frequent entries are identical across heads and are markdown and
LaTeX scaffolding ahead of any content word. In the 8,000-entry head, of the
3,997 multi-word entries only 467 (11.7%) are pure letters and
whitespace; 43.9% contain a LaTeX character, 55.0% a digit, 24.7% a
newline. The genuine English phrases exist and are chain-of-thought boilerplate
— ’We are given’ , ’ to find the’ , ’ the number
of’ , ’ Final Answer’ .

Out of domain the profile inverts: LaTeX falls from 41.3% of banked tokens to
11.7%, plain words rise from 5.5% to 22.6%, single-word entries from 12.4%
to 35.7%, and landing drops from 0.817 to 0.509. There is no formatting
skeleton in conversation to harvest, so the drafter falls back on short common
words. The transfer gap is not a mystery to be excused; it is the direct
consequence of what a maths-distilled vocabulary contains.

The word counts use the regex the heads were trained with: a word is a run of
alphanumerics plus its leading whitespace, or one standalone punctuation
character. The 8,000-entry head therefore holds exactly 4,003 one-word
entries, which is UNI_FRAC = 0.5 =0.5 of its budget, and no entry exceeds MAX_GRAM = 3 =3 . Because punctuation counts as a word, a “3-word”
entry is often a LaTeX fragment such as ’ \frac{’ rather than three words.

The 21.94 M head’s three sets happen to span a factor of two in tree width, and

blocks.en:
Ordering the rows by tree width gives pass costs of 40.6, 39.7 and 41.2 ms —
no trend over a 2.1 × \times range in rows. Verifying 46 candidate positions instead
of 1 costs about 5 ms on top of a 36 ms pass, and the extra memory is under
three quarters of a gigabyte. Candidates are therefore cheap up to the point
where tokens per pass saturates, which is what makes the best- N N -per-set choice
a matter of acceptance rather than of cost. Across both highlighted heads and
all three sets the overhead is + 4.2 +4.2 to + 5.5 +5.5 ms per pass; EAGLE-3 measured
on the same card and prompts adds + 9.7 +9.7 to + 13.8 +13.8 ms, so ours is between a
third and a half of theirs.

在同一卡和提示上,加+9.7+9.7加+13.8+13.8 ms,所以我们的在a之间

First unambiguous positive: a head drafting into Sarvam’s low-fertility Indic
vocabulary, SLEM-expanded, verified through a tree mask against Qwen3-4B, at
1.82 × \times Telugu, 1.49 × \times Kannada and 1.29 × \times Hindi for + 0.43 % +0.43\% parameters.

词汇表, SLEM 扩展, 通过树面具对 Quen3-4B 进行校验, at
1.82×时间 泰卢固, 1. 49 × 时 坎纳达和1.29 × 时间 印地语表示+0.43 %+0.43\%参数.

blocks.en:
Dropped the dependency on an existing Indic tokenizer. The draft vocabulary is
built from the target’s own distilled completions, so the method needs no second
tokenizer to exist. Scaled to 22 languages and two targets.

由目标本身的蒸馏完成制成,所以方法不需要秒
表示器存在。 规模化为22种语言和2个目标.

blocks.en:
Depth, attention, convolutional attention and multi-layer MLPs all lost. A sweep
of seven tree shapes at matched budget found that width wins, depth loses, and
the first word is everything. The survivor is a two-LayerNorm MLP.
blocks.zh:
深度,注意力,进化的注意力和多层次的MLP都丢失了. 扫荡
在匹配的预算下,七棵树形状中发现宽度胜负,深度损失,
第一个词就是一切 幸存者为双拉耶诺姆MLP.

blocks.en:
A single combined head matches or beats per-language heads at a fraction of the
parameters, and on Qwen it beat them. The correct claim is one shared head plus
on-policy training: the shared head starts worse, because four disjoint scripts
dilute it, and on-policy training recovers it. A script-rate gate at 0.50
ensures a speedup on off-target output cannot count.

单个组合头匹配或击打每个语言头的一小部分
参数,在Quen上它打败它们。 正确的说法是共用一个头加
政策培训:共享头开始更糟糕,因为四个脱节脚本
淡化它, 和关于政策的培训恢复它。 0.50的脚本速率门
确保离目标输出速度不能计数。

blocks.en:
One caveat belongs with these two numbers. Gemma-3’s tokenizer is far less
Indic-hostile than Qwen3’s: on the same 23-language measurement it spends 1.48
tokens per Hindi word and 3.05 per Telugu word, against Qwen3’s 5.00 and 11.73,
for an Indic average of 3.38 against 8.68. The Indic results are therefore
measured on the low -fertility target, where the headroom
Section 3.3 ’s argument identifies is smallest. The high-fertility case
is largely unrun.

blocks.en:
The first attempt to make the drafter adapt while it works. Qwen3-4B, maths
only, one seed: 10,000 prompts distilled by the target at a 512-token cap
(mean 278 tokens, 8.5% truncated) build a 40,000-entry vocabulary; an
11.658 M head, 0.2898% of target, is fitted on it at top-1 0.441, recall@8
0.742 and ebank@8 1.576; then a 5,000-prompt stream is walked in blocks of
1,000. After each block the vocabulary grows with units the target itself
emitted and the MLP continues training on that block’s own output, and the
200-prompt held-out test pool is re-measured every time. Baseline
62.5 ms/tok.

What moved is landing: 0.736, then 0.759, then 0.764, monotone, for + 0.028 +0.028 over two blocks. Tokens per pass gained + 0.046 +0.046 on the first block and then
flattened, and speedup moved + 0.034 +0.034 and came back, which is inside
run-to-run noise. Adaptation is cheap: the vocabulary update costs 3–4 seconds
per block and the MLP update about 5 minutes, against roughly 2.4 hours of
streaming, so cost is not what limits this.

所以成本不是限制这一点的原因

blocks.en:
Why it is open rather than a result. Four things are not yet right. The
vocabulary is additive only, with no eviction, so this measures growth and not
replacement. Only 30% of the distilled tokens fit the feature budget, 0.84 M
of 2.78 M positions, so “trained on 10k prompts” overstates it. Each online
update used 200k of about 303k available positions, because the feature tensor
is never freed. And there is no frozen control, so a rising curve cannot yet be
separated from drift in the stream. What is supportable today is that landing
rises under online adaptation at negligible cost, and that speedup has not yet
followed.
blocks.zh:
为什么它是开放的而不是结果。 四事未对. 那个
词汇仅是添加剂,没有拆迁,所以这个措施是增长而不是增加。
替换。 只有30%的蒸馏代币符合特色预算,0.84兆
总计 2.78 M姿势,因此“在10千个提示上训练”过分夸大其词。 每个在线
更新使用约 303k 可用位置中的 200k , 因为特性显示器
从未被释放。 没有冰冻的控制 所以升起的曲线还不能
与溪流中的漂流分开。 今天可以支持的是登陆
在线改造成本微乎其微,但速度尚未加快
随顺.

This is where the 8,000-entry head comes from. Across those five tok/pass cells
it stays within − 2.7 % -2.7\% to + 4.1 % +4.1\% of the 40k head at 29.5% of its
parameters, which is what Section 3.1 ’s saturation claim rests on.
It also beats the 40k head on MT-Bench at every N N — 1.653 against

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Every limitation below is measured in this paper rather than anticipated.
blocks.zh: 本文件衡量以下各项限制,而不是预期的。

blocks.en:
• The denominator is fragile. The library version alone is worth
5.7–9.1% of a speedup number, and across three runs the same arm on the same
card spans 5.7% on MATH-500. Section 3’s rescaling removes a per-version and a
per-run drift together and the two cannot be separated from these readings. • One card, one seed, small sets. 50/50/40 prompts, batch 1, and
no confidence intervals. Section 4 item 10 is the only
cross-hardware check. • Maths only. Every head is trained on maths distillation, so
MT-Bench is zero-shot throughout and Section 3.1 shows the
transfer gap is a direct consequence of what the vocabulary contains rather
than an incidental shortfall. • The Indic case is measured on the wrong target. Gemma-3 spends
3.05 tokens per Telugu word against Qwen3’s 11.73, so the Indic numbers come
from the low-fertility target, where the headroom this paper’s argument
identifies is smallest. The high-fertility case is largely unrun. • Online adaptation is not yet a result. Additive vocabulary with
no eviction, 30% of distilled tokens inside the feature budget, and no frozen
control, so a rising landing curve cannot be separated from drift in the
stream. • Neither head beats EAGLE-3 at tree-60 on any set. The claim is
parameter efficiency at a comparable operating point, not a new state of the
art in raw speedup.

blocks.en: 6 What to run next
blocks.zh: 6个 接下来要运行什么

blocks.en:
1. Limits of the MLP head , mapped over parameters × \times draft-vocabulary size × \times data distribution rather than one axis at a
time, since Section 4 item 9 varies only the entry count and
Section 3 only the trained head, so the three have never been crossed. Code is
the open cell, where the constraint is data rather than capacity. 2. Indic is undertrained, and it has more headroom than maths or
code. The Indic signature of high expansion with low landing (Telugu 4.528 /
0.302 against Hindi 2.148 / 0.673) is what undertraining looks like: the
entries are long and the predictions are missing. The headroom has a measured
basis: the Indic runs used Gemma-3-1B, whose tokenizer spends 3.05 tokens per
Telugu word, while Qwen3 spends 11.73 on the same measurement, so the target
with 3.8 × \times the fertility has never carried a phrase head. Where fertility is
worst, completing a single word is already a large win before any multi-word
phrase, so the target there is 4–5 × \times rather than 2 × \times . 3. Domain fertility, and whether a phrase vocabulary can grow past
three words. Measure fertility and phrase-length distribution per domain, then
test whether continual adaptation can push MAX_GRAM beyond 3 where
the domain supports it. AdaptiVocab reports token savings plateauing by n = 4 n=4 ,
so this is an open question rather than a safe assumption. 4. On-device deployment, end to end. Can a mobile accelerator path
express the 4D tree mask at all; does a small N N fit inside an 8 GB device’s
memory budget, given the 0.72–0.73 GB of verifier overhead
Section 3.2 measures on a 24 GB card; does it hold up under
sustained load and thermal throttling; and does it deliver the speedup. The
metric is sustained throughput over minutes and energy per token, not peak
tokens per second. 5. The personal-assistant distribution. Every head here is trained
on maths distillation, so the test that matters is the request mix an on-device
assistant actually receives, where the useful vocabulary is likely far smaller
than 8,000 entries. The question is whether a small adapter is enough to put
a local model at human reading speed.
